Question: Are there any European countries (or America) that are directly recruiting lower ranking military personnel straight from Africa without any hustles of migrating first?
Answer: Thanks for the A2A. Yes, Russia recruits mercenaries from all over. They will send foreign soldiers in “meat attacks”, so they are usually killed within two weeks of arriving in Russia. They never get paid, and their families get no compensation since the deaths are never reported.

Name: Mats Andersson
Question: If Russia succeeded in dissolving Ukraine would there be insurgency with enough support like the Taliban? Would Russian troops be trapped in cities? How long would it take Russia to turn Ukraine into a fully submissive Russian territory?
Answer: Thanks for the A2A. They tried it with Poland for some 50 years, and failed utterly. Russian soldiers could only leave their barracks in groups of three or more; single soldiers just disappeared. Some might have defected, some were definitely killed. In general, you need one soldier to keep 50 civilians subdued. That’s ordinary occupation, with a largely indifferent or vaguely hostile population. In the case of Ukraine, they will have a totally enraged population, and will need more soldiers. This means they will need more than 800,000 soldiers bearing arms, and maybe 400,000 support personnel (less than the ordinary ratio; they’re not going to need fighter jets and the like for this purpose, so there will be a higher proportion of armed soldiers than in a normal military). More than 1.2 million people – a 50% increase from pre-war staffing. Russia can not afford this. Simple as that. Ukraine will be a net drain on an already poor country, and they won’t have the 50 years they got in Poland before Russia collapses.

Question: How come Algeria allowed that trans boxer to compete in the Olympics? Some Muslim countries are not very open and they will not allow gay and trans people.
Answer: She is not trans. She has a condition called androgen insensitivity. This is usually caused by a faulty SRY gene. What happens is that the cells in the developing embryo are totally insensitive to the hormones that are supposed to turn the embryo into a male foetus. In the absence of those, the embryo “defaults” to female. All mammals function like this. The child that is born will look 100% female. The individual will go on to have a vagina, have wide hips, develop breasts, have no beard, the whole lot that tells you “biologically female” – except for one small difference on the inside: no ovaries. Instead, there are undeveloped testicles that don’t produce testosterone. Most people with androgen insensitivity go through their entire lives not knowing they have a Y chromosome. They are, for all intents and purposes, women – only they are sterile, since they don’t have ovaries. If they go to have an examination regarding their childlessness, it might reveal the truth; in the case of the Algerian boxer, it was determined via a gene test (and subsequent examination, of course).

Name: Mats Andersson
Question: What does Mats Andersson think of the USA?
Answer: Thanks for the A2A – and goodness me, do you have a day or two to read all of it? I’ve worked with the USA extensively. I have lots of American friends. I’ve spent a total of ten weeks in the USA. It’s part of my job to keep up with US culture, including politics and other current affairs. The country spans a freakin’ continent, and has 350 million people in it. I think a lot of different things, some of it contradictory, because a place that big will contain multitudes. (Yes, that was intentional.) OK I’ll give you the TL; DR version. First of all, at its best, USA really is that shining beacon at the hill. Champion of democracy and human rights. I once sat by the Liberty Bell in Philadelphia and said to my friend Jo “OK, much as I like to remain unimpressed, this really was the birthplace of modern democracy.” An inspiration for us all, the place where the future is born. Explorer of new ways to live and exist, some successful and some not so much, from mundane things like ATM machines to weird hippie communes; there’s room for everything and everyone. Sometimes, the beacon gets sort of grubby. The whole Vietnam war was like a pigeon shat on it, to be honest. But it still acts like that beacon to Americans; they want to wipe it off and do better. That’s the best of Americans: when they work as per their specs, they strive to do better. At its worst… it’s the place where people still think slavery was better, the place where their thinking proves that they fought on the wrong side in WWII – they had the same world view as the Axis, they just cheered for a different country – and the place where the future goes to die. A place where bigotry and religious fundamentalism and sheer insane conformism reigns supreme. You’ll never, ever, find the same foaming-at-the-mouth conformism in Europe as in the average American HOA. A place where a person like Trump can even be considered not only for the post of vice-chairman of a stamp collector’s club, but for actual President. A place that claims to be the richest country on the planet, and where people are actually allowed to starve and die from preventable diseases. A place that hates and despises the very Enlightenment from which it was born. A place where a toddler shits on the beacon, and everyone cheers and says it’s the best thing ever. Whenever I criticize that second place, it’s to remind Americans that they actually aspire to be that first place. It’s really a place you can’t reach. It’s a goal, and it pulls you further by always being just out of reach. If you ever think you’ve reached it, you’re doing it wrong. Some people get very, very upset when I say they haven’t reached it. It’s invariably those who aren’t even trying.

Question: How is it posssible that the Soviet Union turned the tide of the war against the much stronger Nazi Germany after 2 years, while Russia can't win against the much smaller and weaker country of Ukraine today?
Answer: Two reasons. Lots of people seem to think it was some kind of accident; it wasn’t. Nazi Germany never had a chance. They acted on abysmal intel and their own batshit crazy theories that they were innately superior both to Slavs and to Communists. They only lasted as long as they did through a combination of extreme luck and their enemies believing their bullshit propaganda – and it seems like lots of people are still very eager to believe it.
